meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Flask、Django、FastAPI 等 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service Linux;缺少资源组、计划、Web App 时自动创建,配置启动命令与构建变量,部署后打印提示信息即结束。
howto.when: 当你说「Flask App Service」「Django App Service」等关键词,或要求把 Python 部署到 App Service 时触发。容器应用、Functions、非 Python 等场景不适用。

say.text: 把这个 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: 自动创建资源组、计划、Web App 并部署

say.text: 用 azure.yaml 把 FastAPI 项目部署到 App Service
给这个 FastAPI 应用设好 uvicorn 启动命令再部署

howto.what_en: Claude deploys your Flask, Django, FastAPI or generic Python code to Azure App Service Linux. It creates the resource group, plan and web app if missing, sets startup and build settings, then prints a post-deploy message and stops.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service" etc., or ask to deploy Python to App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions or non-Python.

say_en.text: Deploy this Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: Creates RG, plan and Web App, then deploys

say_en.text: Deploy my FastAPI project with azure.yaml to App Service
Set the uvicorn startup command for this FastAPI app, then deploy
